DETERMINATION

Northgate Advantage has completed a medical necessity review of the inpatient admission identified above. Based on the clinical information submitted and available at the time of admission, an adverse determination, medical necessity, has been issued. The documentation available at the time of admission did not meet inpatient criteria.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODING

CARC CO-50
RARC N115

CRITERIA APPLIED AND FINDINGS

CHF-01: Not met. Diuresis was achieved with a single intravenous dose and could have been managed with oral medication.

CHF-03: Not met. Imaging did not demonstrate acute pulmonary edema.

No additional criteria codes were applied to this determination.

This notice reflects a medical necessity adverse determination for the admission described. The member is not financially liable for services denied under this determination beyond any applicable cost sharing permitted by the plan documents and applicable regulations.

APPEAL RIGHTS AND INSTRUCTIONS

A request for reconsideration may be submitted within the filing window established by the plan. Any clinical rationale submitted in support of reconsideration must map each finding to the corresponding numbered criterion cited above. Submissions that do not address the numbered criteria individually may be returned without substantive review.

Level of care denials are not eligible for provider appeal.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Requests received after that date may be closed without further review. Supporting documentation should reference the claim number and member ID shown above.

A physician reviewer is available to discuss this determination with the treating practitioner upon request through the Utilization Management Department at the number listed on the member identification card.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Northgate Advantage
